units.source_text: 七月三十一日续弈，对局室改在“新上段间”。

en.t: Play resumed on July 31, and the game room was changed to the “New Upper Room.”

units.source_text: 这一套间，分八叠、八叠和六叠三间。

en.t: This suite was divided into three rooms: two eight-mat rooms and one six-mat room.

units.source_text: 三个房间里分别悬挂着赖山阳、山冈铁舟、依田学海书写的匾额。

en.t: In the three rooms hung plaques respectively written by Rai Sanyo, Yamaoka Tesshu, and Yoda Gakkai.

units.source_text: 这个套间是在名人房间的楼上。

en.t: This suite was upstairs from the Meijin’s room.
